title: Kula Today
heading: Today
summary: Cloudbase has come down from its late-morning high and is edging down now. Kula Ag had about half sun over the last hour; cloud reaches all the way to the Summit. Upslope has run since about 08:15 at a light 2 mph, and thermals seem flat. Trades are holding the shear line crossing Kula Highway between Omaopio and the middle Lower Kula Road junction, with no trade air on the lower west slope.
